info.title: OpenNous REST API
info.description: Read and write the OpenNous context graph over HTTP. Authenticate with a workspace API key.

get.description: Filtered, paginated list of people. By default it lists the people the workspace has engaged: replied, met, in the CRM, or added by hand. `include=all` lists everyone, cold leads included, and supports fewer filters. Unknown query parameters return 400. Teammates, personal contacts, and product signups are excluded. A member key sees only its own book.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match on email, first name, last name, company, and LinkedIn URL.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Exact match on the person's source.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact match on the person's status.

parameters.name: linkedin_url
parameters.description: Exact LinkedIn URL match. Trailing slash and `www` variants match.

parameters.name: has_email
parameters.description: Only people with, or without, an email.

parameters.name: has_linkedin
parameters.description: Only people with, or without, a LinkedIn URL.

parameters.name: icp_fit
parameters.description: Only ICP fits (score 70 or higher), or only non-fits.

parameters.name: last_activity_after
parameters.description: Active within this window, for example `7d`.

parameters.name: last_activity_before
parameters.description: Quiet for at least this long, for example `30d`. Includes people with no activity.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Only people at one account. Entity UUID or domain.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `all` lists everyone, cold leads included. With `all`, only `search`, `pipeline_stage`, `email`, `has_email`, `icp_fit`, `min_icp_score`, `last_activity_before`, `last_activity_after`, `account`, and `sort` (not `recently_added`) are supported, and the page size defaults to 50, max 200.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Used when `offset` is not set.

value.detail: unsupported query param(s): foo
unsupported sort 'name'
include supports only 'all'

404.description: `account` matches no account visible to this key.

get.description: One person. Identity, title, the account they work at, stage, ICP fit, recent activity, and the deals they are on.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Person entity UUID, email, or LinkedIn URL.

recent_activity.summary: Thursday works. Can you bring pricing for 40 seats?

400.description: `id` is not a UUID, email, or LinkedIn URL.

example.detail: :id must be a person entity UUID, an email, or a LinkedIn URL

404.description: No person matches, or the person is outside this key's book.

get.description: Filtered, paginated list of accounts. By default the same set the app's Accounts list shows: accounts with an open or won deal, a recent loss, or recent activity. `include=all` lists every account. A member key sees only its own book.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match on name and domain.

parameters.name: icp_fit
parameters.description: ICP fits (score 70 or higher), or non-fits.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: CRM owner. An email or a name.

parameters.name: has_open_deal
parameters.description: With, or without, an open deal.

parameters.name: last_activity_after
parameters.description: Active within this window, for example `7d`.

parameters.name: last_activity_before
parameters.description: Quiet for at least this long, for example `30d`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `all` lists every account, not just the default set.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order, highest first. `win_chance` ranks by the chance to win within 30 days, adds `win_probability` and `close_within_30d`, and caps `limit` at 50.

value.detail: unsupported query param(s): foo
last_activity_before must look like 30d, 12h or 90m
the owner filter needs account ownership, which this workspace does not have yet

503.description: `sort=win_chance` and the win model could not run.

get.description: The full record for a person or company. Facts with confidence and freshness, durable facts, saved documents, the buying committee, ICP fit, the timeline, and for a company its people and deals.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Entity UUID, email, LinkedIn URL, or domain.

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: Adds `key_activity` and `activity_summary`, ranked for this task.

parameters.name: compress
parameters.description: Return only the ranked view and drop `recent_observations`.

200.description: The account record, or candidates when the identifier is ambiguous.

facts.content: Budget approved for Q4, owned by the CRO.

focus.description: Email, LinkedIn URL, domain, entity UUID, CRM deal UUID, or `implied:<account_id>`.

budget_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for the block.

200.description: The context block, or candidates when `focus` is ambiguous.

question.description: What you want to learn. Enables semantic ranking and is echoed back.

get.description: Deals, CRM and implied, filtered and paginated. Read-only. The CRM is the source of truth. A member key sees deals on its own accounts.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Only one account's deals. Entity UUID or domain.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: CRM pipeline id. Excludes implied deals.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: CRM owner. An email or a name.

parameters.name: closing_within_days
parameters.description: Open deals with a close date from today to N days out. Excludes implied deals.

parameters.name: implied
parameters.description: `true` for implied deals only, `false` for CRM deals only.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `close_date` is soonest first. The others are highest or newest first.

status must be one of open, won, lost
that name matches several records; pass an entity id or a domain

get.description: The CRM pipelines and their stages, each mapped onto the standard ladder. A workspace without a CRM gets `implied: true` and its own stage ladder.

deals.description: Omitted for member keys on a closed workspace.

implied.description: True when there is no CRM pipeline.

post.description: Keep a note, brief, or transcript on a person or company. Append-only and dated. Creates the person or company when the email, LinkedIn URL, or domain is new.

focus.description: Email, LinkedIn URL, domain, or entity UUID. Never a bare name.

content.description: The note text. A line or a full transcript.

date.description: The relevant date, for example the meeting date. Defaults to now.

example.title: Discovery prep
example.content: Goals: confirm budget owner, map the committee, agree a pilot scope.

note.content: Goals: confirm budget owner, map the committee, agree a pilot scope.

value.detail: provide an entity id, email, LinkedIn URL, or domain — not a bare name

get.description: Saved notes, newest first. Optionally for one person or company.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Only notes on this person or company. Email, LinkedIn URL, domain, or entity UUID.

200.description: A page of notes, or candidates when `focus` is ambiguous.

has_more.description: True when the page is full.

get.description: The Insights board. What customers said about your product, sales, success, and market, tied to the account that said it. Only sorted insights linked to an account appear, never lines your own team said. Newest first. Unknown query parameters return 400.

parameters.name: subtype
parameters.description: What kind of work. Must belong to `lane` when both are set.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Only insights from one account. Email, LinkedIn URL, domain, or entity UUID. A bare name returns 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only insights on or after this ISO date, for example `2026-09-01`.

200.description: A page of insights and the workspace taxonomy.

insights.content: Wants CRM sync to write call notes back to HubSpot.
insights.quote: If it doesn't land in HubSpot, my reps won't see it.
insights.speaker: Sarah Chen

subtypes.label: Bug
subtypes.definition: something in our product is broken or fails

subtypes.label: Friction
subtypes.definition: it works, but it is manual, slow, clunky or confusing to use

subtypes.label: Feature request
subtypes.definition: they want a capability we do not have

subtypes.label: Objection
subtypes.definition: a reason the buyer gives against buying, switching or renewing with us, other than price

subtypes.label: Pricing
subtypes.definition: cost, fees, per-use charges, discounts, value for money

subtypes.label: Pitch & messaging
subtypes.definition: the buyer misunderstood or questioned what we are or do, or reacted to how we framed it

subtypes.label: Setup
subtypes.definition: getting it running: install, integrations to switch on, logins, access, provisioning

subtypes.label: Training & adoption
subtypes.definition: staff not using it, needing training, materials, champions or follow-up

subtypes.label: Competitors & partners
subtypes.definition: other vendors and incumbent tools, partners, and the rules they set

subtypes.label: Who buys
subtypes.definition: roles, decision makers, customer segments and how customers operate

value.detail: unsupported query param(s): type
'pricing' belongs to the 'sales' lane, not 'product'
since must be an ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-01
provide an entity id, email, LinkedIn URL, or domain — not a bare name

404.description: `focus` matches no account visible to this key.

503.description: The Insights board is not set up on this instance yet.

post.description: Record what a call or email taught you about your own business. Workspace-level, with no account. Near-duplicates of existing insights are skipped.

post.description: Run the workspace's enrichment providers (Apollo, Prospeo, Findymail) on one person, then rescore it against the ICP. A person enriched in the last 90 days is returned as is, with nothing spent, unless `force` is true.

force.description: Enrich again even inside the 90-day reuse window.

200.description: The person after enrichment, or the earlier result when it was reused.

enriched.description: True when this run found data.

provider.description: The provider that answered this run. Null when nothing ran or nothing was found.

fields_added.description: Fields that were empty before and hold a value now.

cached.description: True when a recent enrichment was reused and no provider was called.

example.detail: :id must be a person entity UUID

404.description: No active person with that id, or not visible to this key.

example.detail: connect an Apollo (with "use for enrichment" on), Findymail or Prospeo key to enrich

post.description: Score a lead against your ICP. Pass one of `identifier`, `identifiers`, `attributes`, or `leads`. Graph leads are scored and the score is kept. Leads scored from attributes are scored inline and nothing is written.

identifier.description: One lead in the graph. Email, domain, LinkedIn URL, or entity UUID.

leads.description: Up to 1000 cold leads, scored inline. Add `ref` or `id` to a lead to get it echoed back. A lead may also be `{ref, attributes}`.

intent.description: Why you are scoring. Recorded, does not change the score.

leads.title: Head of RevOps
leads.headline: RevOps at a Series B SaaS

200.description: One result, or `{results}` for batches. `leads` batches also return `persisted: false`.

400.description: Nothing to score, or a batch is empty or too large.

get.description: The GTM brain's index and every page path. Read this first.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Page path from the index, for example `Playbooks/ICP`.

put.description: Save the next version of a writable page. Writable pages are the playbooks (`Playbooks/Positioning`, `ICP`, `Market`, `Distribution`, `Pricing`), `Decisions`, `Playbooks/Competitors/<name>`, `Working Documents/<name>`, and `Archive/<name>`.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace API key. Create one in **Settings → API keys**.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same key, sent as a header.

Error.description: Every error response. `error` is a stable machine code. Some errors add fields such as `detail`, `supported`, `max`, or `reason`.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation, when there is one.
Company or title, to tell candidates apart.

Ambiguous.description: Returned with HTTP 200 when the identifier matches more than one record. Pick a candidate and call again with its `entity_id`.

Person.description: A person as the People view projects it. Fields are null when unknown. Extra fields may appear.

entity_id.description: Same as `id`. Present on create, update, and enrich responses.

company_id.description: The company entity this person works at.

Fact.description: A durable fact learned about the account.

quote.description: The verbatim line the fact came from, when there is one.

source_ref.description: Pointer to the call or message the fact came from.

outcome_score.description: The realised outcome (0 to 1) once the deal has resolved.

Layered.description: The layered ICP read. A layer missing from `layers` is unknown, never zero.

missing.description: Layers with no evidence yet. Enrich these.

play.description: The suggested next move as a short sentence. Starts with `work now`, `work`, `research`, `nurture`, `enrich`, or `suppress`.

scorecard.description: The latest call scorecard, when the account has one.

key_activity.description: Present when `intent` or `compress` is set. Activity ranked by how much it tells you.

note.description: Says what was left out, when anything was.

people.description: Up to 50 people at the account. Companies only.

deals.description: The account's deals, or its implied deal when it has no CRM deal. Companies only.

ContextClaim.description: A fact with metadata only when something is off. A bare property and value is observed, current, and confident.

deal.description: When `focus` is a deal. The deal with its stakeholders and the objections, competitors, budget, and timeline filed to it.

meetings.description: Next and last meeting with attendees. Only for `meeting_prep` and `call_prep`.

workspace.description: Your own ICP and positioning facts that apply to the task.

property.description: Property prefix. `interaction.email` covers sent and replied.

entity_id.description: Scope to one person or company.

since_days.description: Only activity in the last N days.

facts.description: Search durable facts instead of activity. Needs `question`.

reporting.description: Return distilled objections and themes for a seat.

role.description: With `reporting: role`, the seat to report for.

items.description: One row per observation, per entity, or per fact, depending on `return` and `scope.facts`.

when.description: Meeting start or commitment due date.

source_ref.description: The call or message the insight came from.

persisted.description: False for inline scores. Nothing was written.

ref.description: Echoed in `leads` batches when the lead had a `ref` or `id`.

ScoreAttributes.description: A lead that is not in Nous. Aliases in brackets are accepted.

closed_at.description: When it closed. Future dates are clamped to today.

stage.description: How far this person's thread has gone.

stakeholder_of.description: Deals this person is a stakeholder on.

stage.description: The furthest stage among the account's people.
The stage as the CRM (or the workspace's own ladder) names it.

win_probability.description: Chance the deal is won. Open deals only.

close_within_30d.description: Chance it is won within 30 days. Open deals only.

implied.description: True for an account's implied deal, which is not a CRM record.

role.description: Their role in the decision, from what was said about them.

claims.description: Objections, competitors, budget, and timeline filed to the deal.

email.description: Shown to admin keys, and to a member key for its own row.

WorkflowTrigger.description: `type` plus its settings. `clock` takes `frequency` (default `daily`) and `at` (`HH:MM`, default `08:00`). `before_meeting` takes `offset` in minutes (default 30).

WorkflowStep.description: `type` plus its settings. An `agent` step takes `artifact` (`account_summary`, `call_summary`, `call_score`) or `prompt`. `email` takes `to`, `cc`, `subject`, `body`. `slack` takes `channel`, `text`. `webhook` takes `url`.

artifact.description: What the runner executes: the first agent step's artifact.

prompt.description: What the runner executes: the first agent step's prompt.

destination.description: What the runner delivers to: the first send step.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unknown, or expired API key.

value.detail: This API key has expired. Create or rotate a key to get a fresh one.

ReadOnlyKey.description: A read-only key called a write endpoint.

example.detail: This API key is read-only — it can read context but cannot record, modify, connect, or send. Use a read/write key for write operations.

UpgradeRequired.description: The workspace is past its monthly operations limit and grace window.

RateLimited.description: More than 600 requests in a minute on this key.

EntityNotFound.description: Nothing in the workspace matches the identifier.

Ambiguous.description: The identifier matches more than one record.
